manifest.seed: none — deterministic tokenizer counts, no sampling
manifest.population: 16 fresh mapping-matched range instructions, four per endpoint state, including four descending-as-written cases
manifest.selection: All complete pairs were frozen before tokenizer exposure. Each English arm explicitly states membership of the first and second endpoints as written; each Ainglish arm carries the same instruction with exactly one registered endpoint qualifier.
manifest.method: Under tiktoken 0.14.0, compute tokens(ainglish)-tokens(english) per pair on cl100k_base and o200k_base. Average all 16 items equally per tokenizer and report the maximum tokenizer mean with member span.

estimand.population: the 16 fresh complete range instructions retained in this manifest
estimand.aggregation: unweighted item mean per tokenizer; headline is the maximum tokenizer mean
estimand.comparator: full careful English explicitly naming both written endpoints' membership
estimand.interpretation: token cost only; no claim about comprehension, range validity, fidelity, or adoption

manifest.freeze: The API retained the canonical manifest before this process imported tiktoken or observed token counts.
